page: Microsoft Azure E64d_v4 is an x86_64 memory-optimized server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8272CL processor running at 2.6 GHz. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 32 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The memory configuration provides 504.0 GB of RAM, yielding 7.88 GB per core. Additionally, the instance includes 2458 GB of local SSD storage and operates under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

Benchmark results place the E64d_v4 in the average range for most compute and memory tasks, including stress-ng single-core and multi-core CPU performance, Geekbench multi-core scores, and Passmark memory scores. However, it demonstrates strong performance in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and the Passmark CPU extended instructions test, the latter aided by AVX-512 vector extensions. Conversely, the server exhibits performance limitations in LLM text generation, scoring in the bottom tier for small and medium models.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the E64d_v4 offers high memory density and bundled local SSD storage, reducing the need for external storage attachments for data-intensive operations. The combination of 504 GB of RAM, 64 vCPUs, and local SSD makes this instance suitable for memory-intensive workloads such as relational databases, in-memory caching systems like Redis, data warehousing, and multi-threaded data decompression tasks.
